## Differentiation Timeline

### qPCR

```{r qPCR_results, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

plot_df <- qPCR_df %>%
  mutate(
    Species = case_when(
      celllines == "h21792" ~ "Human",
      celllines == "C3647" ~ "Chimpanzee"
    ),
    timepoint = factor(
      timepoint,
      levels = c("Day0", "Day1", "Day2", "Day3", "Day4", "Day5", "Day7", "Day10", "Day15")
    )
  )

summary_df <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(stage, gene, Species, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(normalization, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem = sd(normalization, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(normalization))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(summary_df %>% filter(stage == "pluripotency"),
       aes(x = timepoint, y = mean,
           color = gene,
           linetype = Species,
           group = interaction(gene, Species))) +
  
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean - sem,
        ymax = mean + sem),
    width = 0.1
  ) +
  
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c(
      "Human" = "solid",
      "Chimpanzee" = "dotted"
    )
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Timepoint",
    y = expression(2^{-Delta*Delta*Cq}),
    color = "Gene",
    linetype = "Species"
  ) +
  
  theme_classic()

```

```{r qPCR_results, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
library(dplyr)
```
```{r qPCR_results, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
library(tidyr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)

# -----------------------------
# 1. Prepare the data
# -----------------------------

heatmap_df <- qPCR_df %>%
  mutate(
    Species = case_when(
      celllines == "h21792" ~ "Human",
      celllines == "C3647" ~ "Chimpanzee",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    timepoint = factor(
      timepoint,
      levels = c(
        "Day0", "Day1", "Day2", "Day3", "Day4",
        "Day5", "Day7", "Day10", "Day15"
      )
    ),
    stage = factor(
      stage,
      levels = c(
        "pluripotency",
        "meso",
        "cmeso",
        "cardiomyocytes"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Species), !is.na(stage))


# -----------------------------
# 2. Average biological replicates
# -----------------------------

heatmap_mean <- heatmap_df %>%
  group_by(stage, gene, Species, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    normalization = mean(normalization, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# -----------------------------
# 3. Create H/C paired columns
# -----------------------------

heatmap_wide <- heatmap_mean %>%
  mutate(
    Species = recode(
      Species,
      "Human" = "H",
      "Chimpanzee" = "C"
    ),
    column = paste(Species, timepoint)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(stage, gene, column, normalization) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = column,
    values_from = normalization
  )


# -----------------------------
# 4. Define desired column order
# -----------------------------

column_order <- c(
  "H Day0",  "C Day0",
  "H Day1",  "C Day1",
  "H Day2",  "C Day2",
  "H Day3",  "C Day3",
  "H Day4",  "C Day4",
  "H Day5",  "C Day5",
  "H Day7",  "C Day7",
  "H Day10", "C Day10",
  "H Day15", "C Day15"
)

heatmap_wide <- heatmap_wide %>%
  dplyr::select(stage, gene, all_of(column_order))


# -----------------------------
# 5. Create matrix
# -----------------------------

heatmap_matrix <- heatmap_wide %>%
  dplyr::select(-stage, -gene) %>%
  as.matrix()

rownames(heatmap_matrix) <- heatmap_wide$gene


# -----------------------------
# 6. Row annotations
# -----------------------------

row_stage <- heatmap_wide$stage


# -----------------------------
# 7. Column annotations
# -----------------------------

column_species <- rep(
  c("Human", "Chimpanzee"),
  9
)

column_time <- rep(
  c(
    "Day0", "Day1", "Day2", "Day3", "Day4",
    "Day5", "Day7", "Day10", "Day15"
  ),
  each = 2
)

top_annotation <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Species = column_species,
  Timepoint = column_time
)


# -----------------------------
# 8. Draw heatmap
# -----------------------------

ht <- Heatmap(
  heatmap_matrix,

  name = "Expression",

  top_annotation = top_annotation,

  row_split = row_stage,

  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,

  show_row_names = TRUE,
  show_column_names = TRUE,

  column_names_rot = 45,

  col = colorRamp2(
    c(0, 0.5, 1),
    c("blue", "white", "red")
  ),

  border = TRUE,

  row_title = NULL,

  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "Normalized expression",
    at = c(0, 0.5, 1),
    labels = c("0", "0.5", "1")
  )
)

draw(ht)

pdf(
  "qPCR_heatmap_D0_then_D2.pdf",
  width = 12,
  height = 10
)

draw(ht)

dev.off()
```

```{r}
# -----------------------------
# 4. Define desired column order
# -----------------------------

column_order <- c(
  "H Day0",
  "H Day1",
  "H Day2",
  "H Day3",
  "H Day4",
  "H Day5",
  "H Day7",
  "H Day10",
  "H Day15",
  "C Day0",
  "C Day1",
  "C Day2",
  "C Day3",
  "C Day4",
  "C Day5",
  "C Day7",
  "C Day10",
  "C Day15"
)

heatmap_wide <- heatmap_wide %>%
  dplyr::select(stage, gene, all_of(column_order))

# -----------------------------
# 5. Create matrix
# -----------------------------

heatmap_matrix <- heatmap_wide %>%
  dplyr::select(-stage, -gene) %>%
  as.matrix()

rownames(heatmap_matrix) <- make.unique(
  as.character(heatmap_wide$gene)
)

# -----------------------------
# 6. Row annotations
# -----------------------------

row_stage <- heatmap_wide$stage

# -----------------------------
# 7. Column annotations
# -----------------------------

column_species <- c(
  rep("Human", 9),
  rep("Chimpanzee", 9)
)

column_time <- c(
  c(
    "Day0", "Day1", "Day2", "Day3", "Day4",
    "Day5", "Day7", "Day10", "Day15"
  ),
  c(
    "Day0", "Day1", "Day2", "Day3", "Day4",
    "Day5", "Day7", "Day10", "Day15"
  )
)

top_annotation <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Species = column_species,
  Timepoint = column_time
)

# -----------------------------
# 8. Draw heatmap
# -----------------------------

ht <- Heatmap(
  heatmap_matrix,
  name = "Expression",
  top_annotation = top_annotation,
  row_split = row_stage,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  column_names_rot = 45,
  col = colorRamp2(
    c(0, 0.5, 1),
    c("blue", "white", "red")
  ),
  border = TRUE,
  row_title = NULL,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "Normalized expression",
    at = c(0, 0.5, 1),
    labels = c("0", "0.5", "1")
  )
)

draw(ht)

pdf(
  "qPCR_heatmap_H_then_C.pdf",
  width = 12,
  height = 10
)

draw(ht)

dev.off()
```
